description: Loads the contractor's price list. Rates are dollars per linear foot by material, then style, then height ("4 ft", "6 ft", "8 ft"). Gates are flat surcharges. Ask the contractor for real numbers; never invent them. Replaces the whole fence catalog each call. Requires org_id and setup_claim from create_contractor_account.

fences.description: material -> style -> height ("6 ft") -> dollars per linear foot

removal_per_ft_usd.description: Old-fence removal, per linear foot; omit to leave unchanged

require_phone.description: Require the homeowner's phone number; default true

name: set_fence_pricing
title: Set the contractor's fence pricing
